sql: select date_trunc('hour', started_at) as hour, count(*) as cycles, sum(errors) as errors, sum(new_terms) as new, sum(changed_terms) as changed, sum(disappeared) as gone, max(coalesce((notes_json->>'deferred_new_terms')::int,0)) as max_deferred, round(max(extract(epoch from finished_at-started_at))::numeric,1) as max_secs, (select max(started_at) from incentive_discovery_cycles) as last_cycle, (select max(last_seen_at) from incentive_programs) as max_last_seen, now() as db_now from incentive_discovery_cycles where started_at > now() - interval '25 hours' group by 1 order by 1
